q1_issues.issue: Inside the sealed complement, the whole investigation proposition is both sealed under `(Theme sk_confirm_1 ...)` and repeated as sibling conjuncts of the same `(And ...)`, giving the non-factive (and modally hedged "can confirm") verb the dual-emit reserved for factives.
`confirm`, a speech verb with a that-clause, takes `Agent` for its holder while the same parse gives `say` the `Experiencer` the attitude rule specifies.

q2_gaps: direct quotation introduced by a colon — the instruction set never says whether quoted speech becomes a sealed that-complement of the quoting verb or something else
first-person "we" inside quoted speech — the pronoun rules cover he/she/they/it only and give no route for binding a speaker pronoun to the quoting subject
notes: Otherwise well handled: the multi-word organization name keeps one opaque symbol plus a separate kind atom, indefinites introduced inside the seal stay sealed while `(Name iraq ...)` projects, and the participial post-modifier "allegations surrounding ..." is correctly expanded as a reduced relative event.
